provenance.note: Place briefs for 25 Gram Panchayats in MOHANUR block: the verdict derived from the tension between tap coverage and the containing taluk's groundwater category, headline facts each carrying their caveat, the named capability gaps, and the detail behind them (habitations, sources, sampling, land, seasonal sources, boundary, rainfall, water bodies). Briefs fail closed: a place must hold identity, population and drinking-water service before it gets a verdict; otherwise it is directory-only and publishes no numbers.

conventions.status: brief-ready | directory-only; a directory-only brief carries no verdict and no headline facts by rule
conventions.tone: positive | warning | neutral | blocked, the same vocabulary the district page uses
conventions.groundwater: every taluk-grain figure says it describes the taluk, not the Panchayat

verdict.body: All 1,919 households report a tap connection, while Mohanur is assessed over exploited at 108.4 percent of extraction. Service is complete; the source is not secure.

headlineFacts.label: Households with a tap connection
headlineFacts.note: 1,919 of 1,919 households, across 3 habitations.

headlineFacts.label: Drinking-water sources
headlineFacts.note: Canal, Deep Tubewell, Open Well, River

headlineFacts.label: Groundwater extraction, containing taluk
headlineFacts.note: Mohanur is assessed over exploited. This describes the taluk, not this Panchayat.

headlineFacts.label: Rainfall, last 30 days
headlineFacts.note: 30 rain days between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-06, modelled rather than gauged.

headlineFacts.label: Last water-quality sample
headlineFacts.note: Safe on 2026-08-29. 107 samples over 5 years, none of them recorded unsafe.
